task.goal: Add a truncate(text, max) function so long text can be shortened to a maximum length with an ellipsis.

acceptance.behavior: truncate(text, max) returns the text unchanged when its length is less than or equal to max.
When the text is longer than max, the result is exactly max characters long and ends with the single character '…'. For example truncate('abcdef', 4) returns 'abc…'.
truncate throws a RangeError when max is not an integer greater than or equal to 1.
truncate is exported from src/index.js alongside slugify and wordCount.

scenarios.omitted: Hidden scenarios are not implemented yet.

nonGoals: Word-aware truncation that avoids cutting inside a word
